k0_status.independent_constraint: No outcome-independent K0 can be derived from current world state: force vectors are applied loads and thin-shell stresses are increments about a zero-load reference; neither supplies prestress. Regional focal mechanisms primarily constrain stress regime and orientation, with heterogeneous local regimes.
k0_status.interpretation: K0=0.6/0.8/1.0 are conditional sensitivity cases, not an observed range or probability distribution. K0=0.8 is a reproduction anchor only. A separate K0≈0.32 near-critical sensitivity follows from the cohesionless normal-fault Mohr-Coulomb ratio at mu=0.6; it is not independent evidence or a K0 estimate.
k0_status.model_definition: effective horizontal background compression / effective vertical overburden
k0_status.production_status: unresolved; do not select a scalar or production field without independent stress magnitudes or a validated tectonic stress model

mantle_creep.limitation: The dry/wet pair is a constitutive sensitivity bracket, not a mapped hydration range. Laboratory power laws are extrapolated to model strain rates.

pore_pressure_scale.limitation: Gradient ratios are illustrative density-only estimates; the true overburden includes changing crust and mantle densities, and connected fluids are not established throughout the mantle lithosphere.

purpose: Independent input-scale bookkeeping; no legacy event labels or loads used.

thermal_profile.limitation: Steady 1-D conduction with fixed conductivity and no advective or magmatic heat transfer.
